label: Coming-to-be horn controls checked (inference)
rule: Explicit interpretations with integer, natural-number and non-negative rational times, checked by case analysis and linear arithmetic
meaning: Each horn survives every bundle with one member omitted. H2 (a non-well-founded populated past, endless or dense) survives state-causal finitism without the precedence bridge, the precedence bridge without finitism, and an earlier-grounded endless past; under the Reaper bridge it fails in every model; on dense time with a first moment it holds while A3 holds, the Reaper bridge fails, and no state-causation relation satisfies finitism and the precedence bridge together (each of those bridges can hold there alone). H1 (a never-generated contingent thing) survives grounding whenever some ground has no earlier presence: simultaneous (controls 4 and 5) or only later (control 7); without a necessary individual only with non-well-founded grounding. The rooted control satisfies every premise and bridge of the new arguments jointly. Model claims concern these interpretations only.
